title: SOC2 risk questions + control mapping (scratchpad)
summary: Working notes for SOC2 readiness: open risk questions, tentative control owners, evidence sources, and action items. Rough draft intended for sync with SecOps and SRE.
content:
Context:
- Purpose: capture open questions and initial control mapping for SOC2 Type II readiness for Redwood Inference (hosted API + dedicated infra). This is a working scratchpad — incomplete, lots of TODOs.

Open questions (high priority):
1) Backup retention for customer data in hosted API: do we currently have automated backups for customer metadata and logs? who owns retention policy? (S3 lifecycle or DB snapshots?)
   - Hypothesis: DB snapshots exist via managed postgres (RDS) daily; logs stored in GCS with 90-day retention. Need owner to surface backup config and retention.
2) Logical access reviews cadence: we need a quarterly attestation for privileged accounts. Who will run reviews (SRE vs IR lead)?
3) Change control evidence: tighten links between PRs, review approvals, and deploys. Are we able to produce a list of PRs + approvals for prod deploys over audit window?

Control mapping notes (rough):
- CC6 (Logical Access Controls) -> Owner candidate: Security & SRE (Priya / Diego). Evidence: Okta admin activity logs, GSuite group membership exports, quarterly attestation spreadsheet (TODO create template).
- CC7 (Change Management) -> Owner candidate: Release Engineering. Evidence: GitHub PRs tagged with release labels, deployment job logs from CI (Circle/GitHub Actions), change calendar exports. Need to formalize a "release checklist" artifact.
- CC8 (System Operations & Availability) -> Owner candidate: Site Reliability. Evidence: runbooks, incident postmortems (PMRs), uptime dashboards (Datadog alerts). Confirm retention of incident PMRs for 12 months.
- CC3 (Vendor Management) -> Owner candidate: Procurement + Security. Evidence: vendor inventory (spreadsheet), SOC2 reports collected from third parties, contracts. Need to confirm which vendors handle customer data (e.g., S3, Datadog, Segment).

Evidence sources (current ideas):
- S3 buckets: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/ (check perms)
- GitHub: repo=infra, search label:soc2-evidence, PRs for architecture changes
- Confluence: SEC workspace, page: "SOC2 artifacts index" (need to create index if missing)
- Okta: admin logs export (30/90 day retention?)

Risks & questions to resolve before next audit prep meeting:
- We don't have an explicit documented retention policy for logs vs backups (technical doc + owner).
- Access review process not automated — spreadsheet is manual and tracked in Drive; auditor may ask for proof of completed reviews and remediation.
- Lack of one-click evidence bundle for change control (need a script or query to extract PR approvals + deploy timestamps for a range).

Immediate action items (who / ETA):
- Ryan: draft backup retention doc and inventory current snapshot schedules; check RDS snapshot retention and GCS/S3 lifecycle rules. ETA: 2026-03-05.
- Maya: pull Okta group exports and list of privileged accounts; confirm admin log retention and export options. ETA: 2026-03-02.
- Priya: compile vendor inventory and mark vendors that process customer data; collect SOC2 reports where available. ETA: 2026-03-09.
- Diego: sample evidence bundle for one prod release in last 6 months (PRs, approvals, CI logs, deploy job). ETA: 2026-03-08.

Notes for sync w/ SecOps (agenda items):
- Confirm control owners for CC6/CC7/CC8 and agree on evidence locations.
- Decide on quarterly cadence for access reviews and owner responsibilities.
- Discuss automation options: scripted evidence export for releases (GitHub API + CI logs).

Loose brainstorm (things to consider):
- Build a single "evidence index" S3 path that stores zipped artifacts per audit window, with manifest.json listing evidence items (makes auditor request simpler).
- Consider using HashiCorp Vault for ephemeral admin creds and rotate integrations — can reduce scope of privileged accounts.
- Small UX for engineers: a checklist template in GitHub PR template to mark when a change touches prod config/security surface (helps change control evidence).

History/notes:
- Previous auditor recommended documented incident response timeline; we have PMRs but need a single index and retention policy.
- Last internal review (2025-09) flagged missing vendor SOC2 report for one analytics provider — follow-up required.

TODOs (short):
- Create backup retention doc + owner (Ryan).
- Create quarterly access review template and attach to Confluence (Maya).
- Build small script to pull PR approvals + CI run logs for a given date range (Diego).
- Start evidence index in s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2026-Q1/ (Priya + infra).

Comments: this is an iterative doc — bring notes to next audit-prep slot. Will convert to a more formal control mapping spreadsheet once owners confirm.
